摘要: We construct non-interactive zero-knowledge arguments for circuit satisfiability with perfect completeness, perfect zero knowledge and computational soundness. The non-interactive zero-knowledge arguments have sublinear size and very efficient public verification. Their size can even be reduced to a constant number of group elements if we allow the common reference string to be large. Our constructions rely on groups with pairings, and security is based on two new cryptographic assumptions; we do not use the Fiat-Shamir heuristic or random oracles.

作者: B. Pinkas; T. Schneider; N. P. Smart; S. Williams
摘要: Secure multi-party computation has been considered by the cryptographic community for a number of years. Until recently it has been a purely theoretical area, with few implementations with which to test various ideas. This has led to a number of optimisations being proposed which are quite restricted in their application. In this paper we describe an implementation of the two-party case, using Yao’s garbled circuits, and present various algorithmic protocol improvements. These optimisations are analysed both theoretically and empirically, using experiments of various adversarial situations. Our experimental data is provided for reasonably large circuits, including one which performs an AES encryption, a problem which we discuss in the context of various possible applications.
